name: Johan's Library
bio: A running list of books I have read.

books.title: The Buffalo Hunter Hunter
books.author: Stephen Graham Jones
books.notes: I really enjoyed this book, a great vampire story.

books.title: What moves at night
books.author: T. Kingfisher
books.notes: It seems I like everything from T. Kingfisher. This read did not scare me as much as the first book in this series but it was a great read anyway.

books.title: What moves the dead
books.author: T. Kingfisher
books.notes: Reading this gave me chills! I read it far too late into the nights but it was a treat!
